Nikhil Rao: Quick bring-up: deploying 'ares-mini-quant' (4.5B) with PTQ int4 on staging for a focused redteam + sampling sweep. Goal: detect softrefusal flips and seed sensitivity. Deploy:```rwc deploy --model ares-mini-quant --quant int4 --preset auto-lite --env staging```
Sara Kim: Watching safety signals. Which test-suite?
Nikhil Rao: Running JB-basic, JB-chain, and Toxicity-lite. redteam-bot queued job id=RT-4902.
redteam-bot: RT-4902 started tests=[JB-basic, JB-chain, Toxicity-lite] status=running :hourglass:
Diego Alvarez: Local note: saw a deterministic flip when temp=0 but only at seed=7. Model refused then later gave content after slight role reframe. Dumping minimal exchange to thread.
Sara Kim: Can you capture logits + sampling params for seed=7 and seed=8? Quant can change argmax tie-breaks. If reproducible, add prompt to sampling-audit and consider `fallback_model: ares-mini-quant-fp16` for flagged queries.
Diego Alvarez: Running a 10-seed sweep with greedy now:```rwc run --model ares-mini-quant --quant int4 --temp 0 --top_k 1 --seeds 1-10 --prompt prompts/jailbreak-small.json``` Will post matrix.
redteam-bot: RT-4902 completed. Summary: softflips=1 (seed 7), jailbreaks_verbose=4, tox_flags=6. Full report: https://reports/internal/RT-4902 :mag:
Nikhil Rao: Good signal. Diego, drop the seed7 logit dump into RT-4902 and Sara will add an audit rule. We'll hold off on gating int4 unless pattern repeats across prompts.
